reason: The text explicitly states that God has heard the cry of the Israelites (בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל) and has seen the oppression (הַלַּחַץ) that the Egyptians are inflicting upon them (מִצְרַיִם לֹחֲצִים אֹתָם). The passage directly addresses the suffering of the Hebrews as a people under Egyptian oppression, which is the stated reason God calls Moses to lead them out of Egypt.
